operation.summary: The health of the services of the ecosystem (operators and administrators)
operation.description: Read only. It answers only once an administrator turned on `ecosystemHealth.enabled`; while it is off a signed-in client gets a plain `404` with no body, exactly as a server without the route would answer. A viewer gets `403`. The port, health path, unit and active state of each service are only in the answer to an administrator.

403.description: Signed in as a viewer: only an operator or an administrator may read the health.

404.description: The option `ecosystemHealth.enabled` is off (the default): a plain `404` with no body, as if the route did not exist.

503.description: The health could not be read.
